from solution import triple_window_sums
assert triple_window_sums('1,2,3,4') == '6,9'
assert triple_window_sums('1,2') == ''
assert triple_window_sums('-1000,0,1000') == '0'
assert triple_window_sums('1,+2,3') is None
assert triple_window_sums('1,,3') is None
